messages.content: Name three fruits that turn yellow when ripe. Write them as a comma-separated list with no other words.
banana, lemon, mango
Write a two-line note to my neighbour Mrs. Fernandes thanking her for watering my plants while I was away.

Dear Mrs. Fernandes, thank you for looking after my plants while I was away.
They are green and happy, and I owe you a box of sweets.
Give me a single sentence that explains what a rainbow is, and make sure it uses the word "sunlight".
A rainbow is a curve of colours that appears when sunlight shines through raindrops and splits into its different shades.
Ayesha is starting at a new school tomorrow. Write three questions she could ask her new classmates, numbered.

1. What is your favourite subject here?
2. Where do you usually sit at lunch?
3. Which teacher gives the most interesting lessons?
Describe the smell of rain on dry earth in under 12 words.
It smells fresh, earthy and warm, like the ground breathing out.
List four indoor games for a rainy afternoon. Start every item with a dash, and keep each item to two words.

- Carrom board
- Card games
- Word puzzles
- Treasure hunt
Write a sentence about a cat sleeping in the sun, using exactly eight words.
The old grey cat dozed in warm sunlight.
My brother Kabir just passed his driving test. Write a congratulations message for him that is exactly three sentences long.
Congratulations, Kabir, you did it! All those early practice drives have paid off. Now you can take me for ice cream whenever I ask.
What are the four seasons of the year in temperate countries? Answer in one line, in the order they come, starting from spring.
Spring, summer, autumn, winter.
How do I make a jug of lemonade? Use exactly five numbered steps and keep each step under ten words.

1. Squeeze two lemons into a jug.
2. Add four spoons of sugar.
3. Pour in a litre of cold water.
4. Stir until the sugar dissolves.
5. Add ice and serve in glasses.
Can you suggest a name for a small bakery? Give three ideas, each exactly two words, and nothing else.

Morning Crust
Golden Oven
Sugar Lane
Write one sentence about a bus ride to Pune that ends with the word "window".
On the long bus ride to Pune, I spent hours watching green hills roll past my window.
Give me exactly four words that describe a good teacher, in alphabetical order, separated by commas.
caring, fair, knowledgeable, patient
Write a short weather report for a summer day in Chennai. Keep it under 25 words and do not use the word "hot".
Chennai will be sunny and very humid today, with temperatures near 38 degrees. Carry water and stay in the shade at noon.
Write an acrostic poem for the word BOOK, one line per letter.

Between the covers, a new world waits.
Old castles, ships and secret maps.
One more page, I tell myself.
Keep reading till the lamp goes out.
In exactly two sentences, tell a friend why you will be late to the party.
My train is running about forty minutes late because of track work. Please start without me, and save me a slice of cake!
List three sounds you might hear in a village at dawn. Number them and use no more than four words per item.

1. Roosters crowing loudly
2. Temple bells ringing
3. Cows lowing in sheds
Explain what a calendar is to a five-year-old. One sentence, under 20 words.
A calendar is a chart of all the days, so we know when birthdays and holidays are coming.
Give two reasons to keep a diary. Use bullet points that start with "*" and keep the whole answer under 25 words.

* It helps you remember small, happy moments.
* Writing down worries can make them feel lighter.
Write a tongue twister about a parrot in which every word starts with the letter P.
Polly's purple parrot pecked plump pink plums politely.
Suggest titles for a story about a girl who finds a lost puppy. Exactly three titles in title case, one per line.

The Puppy in the Rain
Nisha and the Brown Shadow
A Tail Comes Home
Write a reminder note for the fridge about buying milk, eggs and bread. Use all lowercase letters and keep it to one line.
don't forget: milk, eggs and bread on the way home!
Describe your ideal Sunday morning in exactly 15 words.
I wake late, drink tea on the balcony, and read the newspaper without any hurry.
Name five Indian rivers, one per line, in alphabetical order.

Brahmaputra
Ganga
Godavari
Kaveri
Narmada
Use all of these words in one sentence: kite, rooftop, wind, sister.
My sister and I flew a red kite from the rooftop when the evening wind picked up.
Write a polite request to a librarian asking to renew a book. Two sentences at most, and include the word "renew".
Could you please renew this book for me for another two weeks? I have not finished reading it yet.
Give three tips for a first day at a new job, each starting with a verb, in a numbered list.

1. Arrive ten minutes early.
2. Learn your colleagues' names.
3. Ask questions when something is unclear.
Tell me one fun fact about elephants in a single sentence of no more than 20 words.
Elephants use their trunks to drink, smell, grab food and even greet each other.
Write a haiku about a winter morning, following the 5-7-5 syllable pattern.

Cold fog on the street
Steam rises from my tea cup
The sun wakes up late
Plan a simple birthday party for a seven-year-old in exactly four numbered steps.

1. Invite six friends a week before the party.
2. Decorate the room with balloons and paper streamers.
3. Play musical chairs and pass the parcel.
4. Cut the cake and hand out small return gifts.
Say something kind to a friend after their team loses a match. Keep it under 20 words and do not use the words "lose" or "lost".
You played with your whole heart today, and I am proud of you. There is always next time.
Write three sentences about a vegetable market, each on its own line and each starting with the word "The".

The vegetable sellers call out their prices.
The air smells of coriander and ripe guavas.
The crowd moves slowly between the stalls.
Answer with exactly two words: what two things do honeybees make?
Honey, beeswax
Describe a full moon using two adjectives and one noun, nothing more.
Bright, silent lantern
Write a text to my roommate Chloe asking her to buy dish soap. One sentence only, ending with a question mark.
Chloe, could you pick up a bottle of dish soap on your way back from work?
Which days of the week start with the letter T? List them in order, separated by a slash.
Tuesday / Thursday
Write two lines to cheer up a student before an exam. The first line must be a question and the second a statement.

Have you slept well and packed your pens?
Then walk in calmly, because you have prepared for this.
Explain recycling in three short sentences for a primary school class.
Recycling means turning old things into new things. Paper, glass and plastic can be cleaned and made into fresh products. It keeps rubbish out of the ground and the sea.
Come up with a slogan for a neighbourhood cleanliness drive. It must be under eight words and must rhyme.
Keep it neat, from home to street!
List six of the seven rainbow colours, leaving out red, one per line.

Orange
Yellow
Green
Blue
Indigo
Violet
Write one sentence describing a grandfather's hands, using both "rough" and "gentle".
My grandfather's hands are rough from years of farm work, yet they are gentle when he holds a newborn calf.
How can I thank a bus driver at the end of a trip? Five words or fewer.
Thank you for the ride!
Compose a four-line poem about a street dog in which lines 2 and 4 rhyme.

He sleeps beside the corner shop,
His ears alert to every sound.
The children save him bits of bread,
And he follows them around.
I want to cook dal tonight. Give me a shopping list of exactly five ingredients, numbered.

1. Yellow lentils
2. Turmeric
3. Onion
4. Tomato
5. Cumin seeds
What is a good way to open a speech? Answer in one sentence that begins with "Start".
Start with a short story or a surprising fact so your listeners want to hear more.
Write a message to my cousin Tanvi inviting her for Diwali. Use exactly three sentences and include the word "diyas".
Tanvi, please come and spend Diwali with us this year! We will light diyas on the terrace and make rangoli together. Mum is already planning your favourite sweets.
Describe a football in three words, all beginning with the letter R.
Round, rolling, rugged
Here is a challenge: write a sentence about a train with exactly ten words and no letter "e" anywhere.
A long train ran past our farm at dawn today.
Give a two-word name for a robot that helps children with homework, and nothing else.
Homework Hero
Make a three-item checklist for leaving the house. Begin each line with a checkbox like this: [ ]

[ ] Lights and fans switched off
[ ] Gas stove turned off
[ ] Door locked and keys in my bag
